Giant radio galaxies

Jets from supermassive black holes that run millions of light-years beyond their galaxies. Orange: LOFAR's view at 144 MHz (LoTSS DR2, or DR3 where DR2 has no images); background: the optical sky (DESI Legacy Surveys; Pan-STARRS1 for NGC 2300). Drag across the image to measure a distance.

Published lengths

    All of them at one scale

    Lengths: our 3-sigma measurements on LoTSS DR2 (Planck 2018 cosmology), projected on the sky, so true 3D lengths are longer. The Milky Way's disc is ~30 kpc across; Andromeda is 761 kpc away. Data: LoTSS DR2 (Shimwell et al. 2022) and DR3 (Shimwell et al. 2026), DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys DR10 (Dey et al. 2019), Pan-STARRS1 (Chambers et al. 2016).
